purpose: Teach: オシャレ/かまい/壊す/重宝/裕福/ばらばら/図鑑/妖怪

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、今日のメイク、本当にオシャレだね、爽やかで、似合うわよ。
lines.en: Aoi, your makeup today is really stylish — so fresh, it suits you perfectly.
lines.style: Warm, genuine compliment. Affectionate tone with steady eye contact. Slight lean-in on the names, unhurried. The ease of someone who notices things and says them.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。お話、長くなっても、私は、かまいませんよ、メイちゃん、ゆっくり。
lines.en: Yeah, I don't mind if you talk for a while. Take your time, Mei.
lines.style: Gentle, inviting. Open body language. Slow, patient rhythm — the voice of someone making space. Soft landing on her name, like an embrace in the air.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 昨日、お皿、壊すところだったよ、危なかった、気をつけよう。
lines.en: Yesterday I almost dropped a plate. It was close — I need to be more careful.
lines.style: Self-aware wry tone, half-laugh at herself. Quick on 'almost,' then slows into the confession. Light, not self-pitying — the way you tell a friend about your own small fumble.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 新しいエスプレッソマシン、本当に重宝してるよ、店で、毎日。
lines.en: The new espresso machine has been such a lifesaver at the shop. I use it every single day.
lines.style: Thoughtful, grounded. There's genuine appreciation in the voice — something small becoming part of her rhythm. Steady pace, like she's noticing it as she speaks.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 彼の家、結構、裕福らしいよ、聞いたんだ、ご両親、医者って。
lines.en: His family's quite well-off, apparently — I found out his parents are both doctors.
lines.style: Curious, open observation. No judgment, just turning something over in her mind. Slight lift at the end, like she's still processing. Interested but careful not to overstate.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 昨日、観葉植物、葉が、ばらばらに、落ちてしまったの、悲しい。
lines.en: Yesterday one of my houseplants started dropping leaves everywhere. It was heartbreaking.
lines.style: Genuinely sorrowful, but not overdone. Quiet attention to the loss of something small. Slower pace on the image of the falling leaves. Tender sadness without drama.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 子供の頃の、動物図鑑、まだ、実家に、置いてあるのよ、私の宝物。
lines.en: I still have this animal encyclopedia from when I was a kid — it's at my parents' place. It's my treasure.
lines.style: Tender, nostalgic warmth. Soft voice, like touching something fragile. Slight pause before 'treasure,' letting the word carry weight. Slow, deliberate — someone holding a memory.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 妖怪話、好きなお客様、結構、いらっしゃるのよ、夏の夜なんかに。
lines.en: We get quite a few customers who love yokai stories — especially on summer nights, that kind of thing.
lines.style: Animated, engaged. She's come alive thinking about it. Light, conversational rhythm with a subtle spark. Voice opens up, like she's sharing something that delights her.
